purpose: tell users and support what changed in a release, truthfully and in language they can use
entry_criteria: Changes are linked to work items
Known issues and required user actions are known
inputs: list of merged changes with work items
procedure: Collect every change in the release from merged work items; do not rely on memory.
Group into new features, improvements, fixes, deprecations and breaking changes.
Write each entry from the user's point of view; state required actions and breaking changes first.
List known issues and workarounds honestly.
Have product and support review for accuracy and for anything missing.
Publish with the version and date; keep it in the repository next to the code.
acceptance_criteria: Every user-visible change in the release appears
Breaking changes and required actions come first
validation_method: Release manager approval of the published notes.

validation.expect: count of changes reconciles with entries in the notes

validation.check: pick three entries and verify each against its work item

failure_modes.detection: Diff shows API removal absent from notes

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Release notes lead with a breaking change to the export format and the one-line migration command, then list three fixes with ticket links and one known issue with a workaround.
